schemaDraft.recommendation: Use one generic append-only archive table first. Split tables are optional later only if product UI or analytics require typed query surfaces.
rationale: All Phase2 data is TEST/audit evidence, not formal reimbursement or formal workflow data.
A generic archive preserves raw payloads and idempotency without forcing invalid business foreign keys.
It safely holds blocked attachment/message/audit evidence where FileRecord/Notification/AuditLog mandatory User mappings are unresolved.
It allows later promotion into FileRecord/AuditLog/Notification after storage and user mappings are fixed.

model_fields.name: id
model_fields.note: cuid primary key in actual Prisma draft if implemented

model_fields.name: dataScope
model_fields.note: TEST or ARCHIVE_ONLY; never REAL for Phase2 claims

model_fields.name: sourceSha16
model_fields.note: source fingerprint used in idempotency and audit trace

model_fields.name: legacyId
model_fields.note: primary legacy object id for the archived evidence

model_fields.name: legacyClaimId
model_fields.note: for finance and linked OCR/attachment evidence

model_fields.name: storageKey
model_fields.note: durable object key; do not rely on signed URL only

model_fields.name: fileUrl
model_fields.note: optional current URL if present; not the durable idempotency source

model_fields.name: mappedUserId
model_fields.note: optional later mapping; nullable to avoid fake User ids

model_fields.name: blockedReasons
model_fields.note: array of blockers, retained even when row can be archived

model_fields.name: rawPayload
model_fields.note: full source object for audit reconstruction

model_fields.name: testBatchId
model_fields.note: optional TestBatch grouping; TestBatch alone is insufficient as evidence storage

split_table_decision.ExpenseClaimAuditArchive: optional_later_if finance review UI needs typed columns beyond generic evidence fields
split_table_decision.OcrEvidenceArchive: optional_later_if OCR correction/search analytics need typed OCR-specific query model
split_table_decision.LegacyAttachmentArchive: optional_later_if file reachability lifecycle needs a standalone inventory; otherwise use generic archive until FileRecord is extended
split_table_decision.LegacyAuditItemArchive: not needed if generic archive supports actorText/rawPayload; consider only if audit UI requires typed legacy audit filters

reusableAfter: local attachment reachability resolved or explicit metadata-only policy approved

TestBatch.note: can group TEST evidence but cannot store raw legacy evidence by itself

blockers.localAttachmentUnavailable: 6 local/enterprise-cloud reimbursement attachments have no fileUrl/previewUrl and were not found by exact blob-key search under /opt/huigui-crm/storage in v2.
blockers.fileRecordMetadataGaps: FileRecord requires fileUrl/uploaderUserId and lacks storageKey/sourceFile/legacyAttachmentId for durable legacy evidence trace.
blockers.uploaderUserMappingIncomplete: FileRecord.uploaderUserId cannot be filled from legacy owner/uploader text without mapping.
blockers.auditLogUserMappingIncomplete: AuditLog.userId cannot be filled from actor text without mapping; do not fabricate User.id.
blockers.notificationUserMappingAndDedupeIncomple: Notification.userId mapping and weekly notification/report dedupe are incomplete.
